name: Isotretinoin
description: Retinoid (related to vitamin A) taken by mouth as capsules

note.text: All US isotretinoin goes through a restricted program (REMS) because it can cause severe birth defects.

bullets: **Retinoid** that inhibits sebaceous gland function and keratinization (label)
**Less oil (sebum)** goes along with improvement; the drop is temporary (label)
**The exact mechanism** in nodular acne is unknown (label)
No placebo group in that trial

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak 2.9 h fasting, 6.4 h fed; CYP2C8, 2C9, 3A4, 2B6 (in vitro)
practical.monitored: Pregnancy tests, fasting lipids, liver tests, mood, vision

regulatory.text: Approved 1982; boxed warning on birth defects
Checks of mood and sexual function at each visit

references: FDA, Absorica / Absorica LD prescribing information, Aug 2026
MHRA, Isotretinoin: changes to prescribing guidance, Jan 2026
